theme_archetype.rationale: For an eco-friendly grocery app, we need the trust and warmth of organic earth tones paired with the joyful, engaging energy of vibrant play. This prevents the app from feeling like a sterile clinical utility and instead makes sustainability feel fun, approachable, and fresh.

typography.strategy: The 'Soft Utility' - Friendly, rounded headings paired with highly legible, clean body text.

headings.usage: H1, H2, category titles, and price tags. Brings a playful, 'chunky' personality.

body.usage: Product descriptions, UI labels, and eco-impact stats.

spacing_layout.global: Mobile-first approach. For desktop view, constrain the main app container to a mobile size to simulate the app experience.
spacing_layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto relative min-h-screen bg-stone-50 overflow-hidden shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] border-x border-stone-200
spacing_layout.padding_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-4 to p-6 for screen edges. gap-4 to gap-6 for lists.

bottom_navigation.classes: fixed bottom-6 left-4 right-4 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(16,185,129,0.15)] rounded-full px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center z-50

product_cards.classes: bg-white rounded-[2rem] p-4 shadow-sm border border-stone-100 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden

go_green_card.classes: bg-emerald-50 rounded-[2rem] p-6 border border-emerald-200 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.1)] relative overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-transform active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.go_green: bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-emerald-600 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-bold shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_6px_25px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)] transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.icon_only: bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-emerald-950 rounded-full p-3 transition-colors

badges.eco_score: absolute top-4 left-4 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 backdrop-blur-md

inputs.search: bg-white border-none shadow-sm rounded-full px-6 py-4 text-emerald-950 placeholder:text-stone-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 outline-none w-full

icons.style: Duotone or Fill (for active states). Playful, thick, and rounded to match Fredoka typography.

hero_onboarding.description: Person placing bright yellow melon into reusable green bag inside a shopping cart.
hero_onboarding.usage: Onboarding screen or empty cart state.

products_general.description: Colorful assortment of fresh fruits and vegetables

animations.interactions: Use framer-motion for playful, spring-based animations. Buttons should use whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}. Lists should stagger entrance.
animations.page_transitions: Slide up with a slight fade. initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn', data-testid='go-green-substitute').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the main layout simulates a mobile device by constraining width (max-w-md mx-auto) and adding a subtle shadow/border on desktop.
Implement the bottom navigation as a fixed, glassmorphism pill shape.

Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the playful, custom component layouts (like product cards with floating eco-badges) rather than forcing rigid Shadcn components, but use Shadcn for standard interactive logic (forms, dialogs).
For the barcode scanner screen, simulate a camera viewfinder using a bordered overlay with scanning animations.
In the cart, emphasize the 'Go Green' substitute feature prominently, showing clear CO2/packaging savings.
